ai_summary.en: Customers praise the authentic taste, generous portions, and rich flavours.
ai_summary.tr: Müşteriler otantik lezzeti ve cömert porsiyonları övüyor.

reviews.comment: Rich flavour, proper palm oil taste, and the meat portions were generous. Arrived hot and well packaged — easily the best jollof I've had in London.
The jollof rice was amazing and smoky. Pepper soup was a little hotter than expected, but still enjoyable. Will definitely order again.
reviews.restaurant_reply: Customers praise the authentic taste, generous portions, and rich flavours, especially the egusi, jollof rice, and pounded yam. Thank you for the kind words, Tunde — we'll keep the pepper coming!

reviews.comment: Great suya and the zobo was refreshing. Delivery took a little longer than the estimate on a Friday night.
Halal, delicious and the puff puff were still warm. Lovely touch with the handwritten note!
Food was good but my plantain was missing. Support sorted it quickly though.
reviews.restaurant_reply: Sorry about the plantain, Daniel! We've added a little extra to your next order.

reviews.comment: The egusi soup reminded me of home. Pounded yam was perfectly smooth.
First time trying Nigerian food — the asun was spicy but brilliant.
